name: Spotlights
title: Spotlights: operator and guest paths and what can go wrong

BANDS.s: Choose the location and a spotlight type.
Write the offer and choose its destination and images.
Save a draft or make the spotlight available to other surfaces.
Check what guests see and what happens to linked content.

NODES.d: The operator opens the restaurant list and searches or filters by status.
e: A status filter hides a saved draft
Spotlights from the previous restaurant remain visible

NODES.d: Choose Happy Hour, Online Ordering, Catering, Reservations, Gift Cards, Loyalty or Custom. Loyalty depends on restaurant enablement.
e: Loyalty appears for a restaurant without a programme
Wrong preset is kept after changing the promotion

NODES.d: Enter a title of up to 50 characters and a description of up to 400. Titles must be unique within the restaurant.
e: A reused title blocks a seasonal relaunch
Copy omits a condition such as the closing time

NODES.d: Supply a valid web address for the ordering, reservation or other destination.
e: A valid address opens another branch
Guest books or orders at the wrong restaurant
A destination is retired after the spotlight is saved
Guest cannot act on the offer

NODES.d: The media picker accepts up to five images. The service requires unique image entries.
e: A sixth selection is dropped without a clear indication
An image is later removed from storage
Guest sees an empty image area

NODES.d: Review the Type and Content selections. Return to an earlier step to correct text or images.
e: Preview keeps an earlier image order after a correction
Long copy hides the call to action on a narrow layout

NODES.d: Create saves the reviewed spotlight as active. Leaving offers a draft when the form has eligible changes.
e: Leaving an incomplete form discards copy the operator expects to keep
Operator selects Create while intending to save privately

NODES.d: Save as Draft from the exit prompt and find the entry again in the list.
e: Draft is missing from a filtered list
Resuming and saving creates another record

NODES.d: The restaurant has an active record that eligible placements can select. Activation alone does not configure a placement.
e: List shows Active while the chosen surface has no placement
A double submission leaves the operator uncertain which version won

NODES.d: Select an eligible spotlight in a website section, campaign or journey. Image-only selections can omit records with no images. Start campaign on an active spotlight opens campaign creation with that spotlight selected. Confirm the selected source before preparing content.
e: An active text-only offer is missing from an image picker
Placement still references a previous seasonal offer
A spotlight changes after it is selected for a campaign
The preview and eventual placement describe different offers

NODES.d: The guest follows the displayed link from the published surface. Its availability also depends on the receiving surface.
e: Website copy still advertises an offer after its destination changes
A valid destination requires a different restaurant selection

NODES.d: The operator changes Active to Inactive. The service updates linked journeys when the spotlight moves to inactive or draft.
e: One linked journey changes while the status update fails
An already issued message continues advertising a retired offer

NODES.d: Inspect the affected guest surface or journey after a change. Use its own publishing or scheduling workflow where applicable.
e: Reactivation is assumed to restore a removed journey reference
An old message still contains a broken destination

PATHS.n: Create the active spotlight and check a guest placement.
PATHS.s: A1 A2 B1 B2 B3 C1 C2 C4 D1 D2 D4

PATHS.n: Leave the form as a draft and complete it later.
PATHS.s: A1 A2 B1 B2 C1 C2 C3 B1 B2 B3 C1 C2 C4 D1 D4

PATHS.n: Return from Review to repair a link before activation.
PATHS.s: A1 A2 B1 B2 B3 C1 B2 C1 C2 C4 D1 D2 D4

PATHS.n: Skip optional images and select a compatible placement.
PATHS.s: A1 A2 B1 B2 C1 C2 C4 D1 D2 D4

PATHS.n: Deactivate a listed promotion and check its dependent placements.
Make a retired spotlight available again and review guest access.

NOTES: The spotlight form contains Type, Content and Review. The placement owns its schedule. No standalone timed expiry was found in this form.
Image selection, active records and journey detachment were verified in Zeus. Whether a particular previously published placement refreshes immediately requires a check on that surface.
No supplied PROD ticket specifically evidences a spotlight incident.
